The Initial Level of the Underlying is 100% of its official closing level on the Trade Date, as published by the Index Administrator.

payable quarterly, payable quarterly in arrears, on each Coupon Payment Date on which the Coupon Condition is satisfied.

Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost. It will be paid, together with the Coupon then due, on the first subsequent Coupon Payment Date on which the Coupon Condition is satisfied.
Autocall Observation Dates: 3 March 2027, 3 September 2027, 3 March 2028, 5 September 2028.
if on any Autocall Observation Date the closing level of the Underlying is at or above 100% of the Initial Level, the Notes redeem early at 100% of the Notional Amount plus the Coupon then due.
Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis.
Settlement at maturity or upon automatic early redemption is in cash, in CAD.
Payment dates are adjusted in accordance with the Modified Following Business Day Convention.
The Underlying is a rules-based, volatility-targeting index administered by Bloomberg Index Services Limited ("BISL")
